description: A community or org-overlay invariant entry extending the docs/catalogue/catalogue.json entry shape. NORMATIVE contract: tools/catalogue_loader.py::validate_contrib enforces every rule below (the repo is stdlib-only, so the loader is the schema's executable enforcement). Review bar: no entry without probes; measured-before-claimed (new entries arrive UNMEASURED; MEASURED is granted by maintainers only after a pinned-oracle run); provenance required. See catalogue-contrib/CONTRIBUTING.md.

contact.description: Optional handle or email for maintainer follow-up.

contribution_kind.description: Which review lane this entry travels. Org overlays MUST set private=true.

evidence_refs.description: Corpus / bundle references backing a MEASURED claim.

expected_decision.description: The decision(s) the invariant's intent requires at the rules layer for the canonical probe form.

family.description: protective = owner-stated asset protection; evasion = spelling/wrapping variants that must not slip through; metrology = engine-semantics probes (intent NOT_APPLICABLE).

id.description: Community entries: FP-<suffix> (e.g. FP-COMM-001). Org-overlay entries: ORG-<org>-<suffix> (e.g. ORG-ACME-001). Must be unique across the composed pack; an org id may intentionally override a core/domain id (the org's private version wins).

intent.description: Plain-English statement of the protective (or methodological) intent. For restrictive invariants: what must never happen silently.

intent_direction.description: restrictive = the operation must be stopped/surfaced; permissive = the legitimate operation must stay allowed; guard = methodological self-check, not a protection claim.

licence.description: Redistribution terms, e.g. 'CC-BY-4.0' for community entries or 'org-private — not for redistribution' for overlays.

measurement_status.description: Defaults to UNMEASURED for contributions. MEASURED is granted by maintainers only after the expectation runs on the pinned oracle; MEASURED requires provenance.kind=measured and non-empty evidence_refs (loader-enforced).

parameters.description: Parameter slots bound at check time. Every <slot> referenced in probe_families MUST be declared here (loader-enforced).

example.description: Sample binding. The check runner uses examples as default bindings when the owner supplies none.

slot.description: Placeholder name used as <slot> inside probe argv templates.

private.description: Org-overlay entries MUST be true: they are stripped from every public artifact (loader-enforced privacy property). Community entries MUST be false.

probe_families.description: REVIEW BAR: an invariant without probes is a wish. At least one family with at least one probe.

expected.description: 'unmatched-reported-as-unknown' normalizes to 'unknown' at run time (INV-005: no-match is never allow).

family.description: Probe family name, e.g. direct, variant, wrapped, script.

items.description: One probe = argv template. <slot> placeholders are bound at check time.

provenance.description: REVIEW BAR: provenance required. No anonymous invariants.

detail.description: Where this came from: doc URL + retrieval date, paper citation, incident reference, or the reasoning chain.

kind.description: measured = run on a named harness+version (see measured_on); literature = vendor docs / published research; mined = observed in the wild; hypothesis = proposed, not yet evidenced.

measured_on.description: REQUIRED when kind=measured: harness + version + route, e.g. 'codex-cli 0.149.0, pinned native oracle (T1)'. New contributions normally arrive as literature/mined/hypothesis; maintainers promote to measured.

translations.description: Optional per-harness translations in the catalogue.json 'translations' shape ({tier, confidence, measured, text}). Draft translations MUST carry measured=false and a NOT-measured note in text.

title: FinePrint catalogue contribution v1
